title: Community Service Learning
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Run a real small CSL project with the class: identify a need, plan, act, report and reflect.

skills.key_step: The child explains the key terms of CSL and why it matters.

floor.prerequisite: Names ways a school and community work together.
floor.question: Give one way a school helps its community.
floor.answer: any example such as a clean-up

steps: Say what a CSL project is.
Say what the learners and community gain.
contexts: a hand-washing station at a stage

board.do: Write: "a new game for learners" and "clean water at the school gate".

misconceptions.repair: Ask what the learners learn when they plant trees in the village.

listen_for: A new game for the learners
misconceptions.repair: Ask the child who in the community benefits from the project.

misconceptions.ask: How is CSL different from just giving gifts?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what learners learnt while planting trees.

misconceptions.ask: Can a CSL project be done outside the school?
misconceptions.repair: List places near school with needs.

checks.question: What is community service learning?
checks.answer: learning by serving a real community need

checks.question: Give one importance of CSL.
checks.answer: any of: builds skills and values, solves real problems, links school and community

skills.key_step: The child orders the steps of a CSL project and says what a good plan includes.

floor.question: What is CSL?
floor.answer: learning by serving a community need

contexts: a reading corner for small children

board.do: Write the steps in mixed order.

misconceptions.ask: What comes first in a CSL project?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what might go wrong if the class started to dig before they knew what was needed.

misconceptions.ask: What is the last step of a CSL project?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what the class can improve next time.

misconceptions.ask: What should a CSL plan include?
misconceptions.repair: Fill in a plan sheet with four columns.

misconceptions.ask: What does reflecting on a CSL project mean?
misconceptions.repair: Ask two questions: what did we do (report), what did we learn (reflect)?
